יִמָּלֵא הוֹד נוֹכְחוּתְךָ אֶת־עֵינֵינוּ, הוֹי יֵשׁוּעַ
יִמָּלֵא הוֹד נוֹכְחוּתְךָ אֶת־עֵינֵינוּ, הוֹי יֵשׁוּעַ

review: The hymn is the acclamation of the Lamb: 1:1–5 is Rev 5:12 with Phil 2:10–11, 2:1–5 is Isa 40:4 with Luke 3:5, and 3:1–5 is 2 Cor 3:18 (בְּפָנִים מְגֻלּוֹת) with 1 John 3:2.

Each stanza frames its two short middle lines with the same long line repeated at the first, second and last positions, exactly as the print repeats its refrain; the payload keeps all three repetitions verbatim.
3:4 כְּבוֹדְךָ בְּפָנִים מְגֻלּוֹת quotes 2 Cor 3:18's phrase, because the stanza's change is from beholding to being changed and the verse is the only place the two are joined.
